title: 2001 AMC 12 Problem 3
statement: The state income tax where Kristin lives is levied at the rate of \(p\%\) of the first \(\$28000\) of annual income plus \((p + 2)\%\) of any amount above \(\$28000.\) Kristin noticed that the state income tax she paid amounted to \((p + 0.25)\%\) of her annual income. What was her annual income?

solutions.text:
Let her income be \(x \gt 28000\) dollars. Writing the tax with both descriptions and multiplying by \(100,\) \[ \begin{aligned} &p \cdot 28000 \\ &\quad {}+ (p + 2)(x - 28000) \\ &= (p + 0.25)x. \end{aligned} \]

Expanding, every term containing \(p\) cancels, leaving \[ 2x - 56000 = 0.25x, \] so \(1.75x = 56000\) and \(x = 32000.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Let her income be \(x\) dollars with \(x \gt 28000,\) and write the tax two different ways
